semiconductor_relevance: High — Optorun Co., Ltd. specializes in semiconductor equipment, particularly in thin-film deposition and vacuum coating technologies relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Optorun Co., Ltd. manufactures and distributes advanced vacuum coating machines and related equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their focus includes technologies for micro-displays, compound semiconductors, and wafer-level optics, catering to the evolving needs of the optoelectronics market.
